summary: Comprehensive testing of MRX Akademi User Panel (/panel route). Backend: 20/20 tests passed. Frontend: All 12 sections navigable and functional. Core flows verified: auth redirect, login, all sidebar nav items, payments/contracts mock data, exams flow (start → answer → submit → result), calendar navigation, city filter, logout, and 'Panelim' dashboard button.

integration_issues.issue: React hydration warning: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>'. In PaymentsSection and ContractsSection, the {loading ? ... : <table><tbody>{data.map()} results in <tr> elements wrapped in React's span wrappers for conditional rendering. Not visually breaking but is invalid HTML.

issues: Background color #F5E6D3 (light beige) works well with the dark sidebar
All sections are visually consistent and well-designed
Yellow promo banner has good contrast with dark text
Certificates and Transcript sections show empty state correctly (0% progress for test user)

action_items: MINOR: Fix HTML hydration warning in PaymentsSection and ContractsSection - the .map() inside tbody generates <tr> elements wrapped in conditional span wrappers. Consider using fragment rendering or restructuring the conditional so the table is always rendered (hide with CSS or show empty tbody)
critical_code_review_comments: PaymentsSection (line 462-489): `{loading ? <Loader/> : <table><tbody>{data.map(p => <tr>)}` wrapping causes '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' HTML validity error. Fix: move the loading state check outside the table, or render table with empty tbody when loading.
ContractsSection (line 522-548): Same issue - conditional rendering inside tbody creates invalid HTML nesting.
UserPanelPage is 1112 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting section components into separate files.
The 'Panelim' button in DashboardPage uses a button element instead of Link component - minor accessibility concern.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 12 sections functional, all flows working
